evals.prompt: I just got a fresh Ubuntu 22.04 VM from my cloud provider. What do I do first?
evals.expected_output: Routes to linux-server-provisioning (with linux-cloud-init named if the user wants declarative bootstrap). Records the distro family, asks for the intended server role, and does not start running mutating commands without authority. Names the verification target (e.g., service state, firewall status).

evals.prompt: We may have been compromised. I want a security posture report but nothing changed yet.
evals.expected_output: Routes to linux-intrusion-detection for read-only fail2ban/rootkit-scanner evidence, names linux-access-control and linux-firewall-ssl as neighbours, and states that compliance-grade auditing (auditd/AIDE) is outside this skill set. Keeps the first pass read-only, names the report as the output, and does not apply hardening changes.

evals.prompt: The website started returning 502s right after a PHP upgrade last night.
evals.expected_output: Routes to linux-webstack as the primary skill with linux-service-management and linux-log-management as neighbours. Handoff records distro family, affected virtual host, and the recent package change, and requires a read-only first pass (logs, service state) before any reload or rollback.
